info.title: Mavio API
info.description:
Mavio's API is a set of [Connect](https://connectrpc.com) services: each
method is a `POST` to `/<package>.<Service>/<Method>` with a JSON (or
binary protobuf) body, and answers with JSON or a Connect error. The
contracts are the `.proto` files in `libs/proto`; gRPC and gRPC-Web
clients can use the same paths, and the server answers gRPC reflection.

Sign in with `AuthService/Login` and send the access token it returns as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Methods marked as needing no
authentication, such as signing in and the health check, take none.

Media bytes are served over plain HTTP: the files of a playback under
`/media/`, where the playback ID is the credential, and images under
`/images/`, where the image or item ID is. Streaming methods, such as
`EventService/Subscribe`, are not listed here.

connect-protocol-version.title: Connect-Protocol-Version
connect-protocol-version.description: Define the version of the Connect protocol

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is no limit on the number of messages.

type.description: A URL that acts as a globally unique identifier for the type of the serialized message. For example: `type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo`.

value.description: The Protobuf message, serialized as bytes and base64-encoded. The specific message type is identified by the `type` field.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Deserialized error detail payload. The 'type' field indicates the schema. This field is for easier debugging and should not be relied upon for application logic.

connect.error_details.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message, with an additional debug field for ConnectRPC error details.

google.protobuf.Duration.description: A signed duration in seconds, with up to nine fractional digits and an `s` suffix (for example, `3s` or `-0.001s`).

google.protobuf.FieldMask.description: Comma-separated field paths in lowerCamelCase (for example, `user.displayName,photo`).

google.protobuf.Timestamp.description: A point in time in RFC 3339 format, with up to nanosecond precision. Output uses UTC (`Z`); input may use an offset from UTC.

The gain in dB that brings a track or album to -18 LUFS; unset until

externalUrls.title: external_urls

externalIds.title: external_ids
externalIds.description: Keyed by provider: "tmdb", "imdb", "tvdb", …; replaces all of them.

locked.title: locked

scanInterval.description: Period of scheduled reconciliation scans; unset disables them.

Write NFO files and chosen artwork next to the media, where scans read
 them back.

Put movies into collections named after the metadata providers'
 collections (movie sets).

extractTrickplay.title: extract_trickplay
extractTrickplay.description:
Make thumbnail sheets of videos for seeking, and an image of each
 chapter.

analyzeLoudness.title: analyze_loudness
analyzeLoudness.description: Measure the loudness of tracks, for normalization.

mavio.library.v1.Library.title: Library
mavio.library.v1.Library.description: Library is a named set of root folders scanned as one collection.

mavio.library.v1.LibraryKind.description: LibraryKind decides how a library's folders are interpreted.

mavio.library.v1.LibrarySpec.title: LibrarySpec
mavio.library.v1.LibrarySpec.description: LibrarySpec holds the client-settable fields of a library.

itemKind.title: item_kind
itemKind.description:
Unset lists the kinds of every item kind and of persons.

recursive.title: recursive
recursive.description: Include all descendants of parent_id instead of direct children.

mavio.library.v1.ListItemsRequest.title: ListItemsRequest
mavio.library.v1.ListItemsRequest.description:
ListItemsRequest filters items; unset fields do not filter. Per-user
 filters and sorts apply to the calling user.

total.title: total
total.description: Number of matching items across all pages.

kinds.title: kinds
kinds.description:
Unset means the items played or viewed: movies, episodes, videos,
 tracks, music videos, audiobooks, books and photos.

played.title: played
played.description: Filters by the caller's played state.

ungrouped.title: ungrouped
ungrouped.description:
Lists every new item instead of grouping them: grouped, the new tracks
 of an album are listed as the album, and the episodes of a series
 added within a day of its newest one as their season when they are
 all in one season of a series with several, as the series when it has
 one season or they span several, and as the newest episode when it
 came alone.

mavio.library.v1.ListLatestItemsRequest.title: ListLatestItemsRequest
mavio.library.v1.ListLatestItemsRequest.description:
ListLatestItemsRequest selects the latest items. Unset fields do not
 filter.

since.title: since
since.description: Leaves out series last played before this time.

includeResumable.title: include_resumable
includeResumable.description: Also offers episodes with a resume position.

mavio.library.v1.ListNextUpRequest.title: ListNextUpRequest
mavio.library.v1.ListNextUpRequest.description:
ListNextUpRequest selects the series whose next episodes are listed.
 Unset fields do not filter.

items.title: items
items.description:
Each series' next episode: the first unplayed episode after the last
 played one, with specials placed by where they air.

creditKinds.title: credit_kinds
creditKinds.description: Count only credits of these kinds, e.g. actors.

mavio.library.v1.ListPeopleRequest.title: ListPeopleRequest
mavio.library.v1.ListPeopleRequest.description:
ListPeopleRequest selects people by the items crediting them: present
 items that are not extras. Unset fields do not filter.

people.title: people
people.description: Ranked by relevance when searching, otherwise ordered by sort name.

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
Unset lists every kind.
enum.defined_only = true

itemKinds.title: item_kinds
itemKinds.description: Count only items of these kinds.

search.title: search
search.description: Matches like ListItemsRequest.search; years cannot be searched.

mavio.library.v1.ListValuesRequest.title: ListValuesRequest
mavio.library.v1.ListValuesRequest.description:
ListValuesRequest selects the items whose values are listed: present
 items that are not extras. Unset fields do not filter.

values.title: values
values.description:
Ranked by relevance when searching, otherwise ordered by sort name
 (years by number).

end.title: end
end.description: Unset for the last word of the lyrics.

mavio.library.v1.LyricCue.title: LyricCue
mavio.library.v1.LyricCue.description:
LyricCue times part of a line: the UTF-16 code units from position to
 end_position.

mavio.library.v1.LyricLine.title: LyricLine
mavio.library.v1.LyricLine.description:
LyricLine is a line, with its start in synced lyrics and its words'
 times in enhanced ones.

mavio.library.v1.MediaSegment.title: MediaSegment
mavio.library.v1.MediaSegment.description: MediaSegment is a stretch of an item, such as its intro.

name.title: name
name.description: Distinguishes versions of the same item, e.g. "4K HDR".

mavio.library.v1.MediaSource.title: MediaSource
mavio.library.v1.MediaSource.description: MediaSource is one playable version of an item.

externalPath.title: external_path
externalPath.description: Set for sidecar files such as "Movie.en.srt".

textBased.title: text_based
textBased.description:
Subtitle. False for bitmap formats (PGS, VobSub), which can only be
 burned in.

mavio.library.v1.MediaStream.title: MediaStream
mavio.library.v1.MediaStream.description: MediaStream is one elementary stream, or a sidecar subtitle file.

mavio.library.v1.MetadataField.title: MetadataField
mavio.library.v1.MetadataField.description:
MetadataField names a group of item fields that refreshes can be kept
 from changing.

position.title: position
position.description: The entry's new position; past the end moves it last.

externalUrls.title: external_urls
externalUrls.description:
Pages of the person on the sites of their external IDs; set by
 GetPerson.

mavio.library.v1.PersonCount.title: PersonCount
mavio.library.v1.PersonCount.description: PersonCount is a person with the number of items crediting them.

mavio.library.v1.PlaylistEntry.title: PlaylistEntry

mavio.library.v1.Rational.title: Rational
mavio.library.v1.Rational.description: Rational is a fraction such as 24000/1001.

replaceMetadata.description:
Forget the metadata the providers gave before, other than external
 IDs, so that nothing stale outlives the refresh.

language.title: language

mavio.library.v1.RemoteImage.description: RemoteImage is an image a provider has.

mavio.library.v1.RemoteSearchResult.title: RemoteSearchResult
mavio.library.v1.RemoteSearchResult.description: RemoteSearchResult is what a provider found.

id.title: id
id.description: The provider's ID, passed to DownloadSubtitle.

mavio.library.v1.RemoteSubtitle.title: RemoteSubtitle
mavio.library.v1.RemoteSubtitle.description: RemoteSubtitle is a subtitle a provider offers.

enqueued.description: False when a scan was already pending or running.

name.title: name
name.description: Unset fields are taken from the item.

provider.title: provider
provider.description: Only search this provider (a plugin ID).

results.title: results
results.description: Each provider's results in its order, providers in turn.

mediaSourceId.title: media_source_id
mediaSourceId.description: The media source; unset means the item's first.

data.title: data
data.description: An uploaded JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF image of at most 20 MiB.

url.title: url
url.description: An http or https URL, such as a RemoteImage's.

bandwidth.title: bandwidth
bandwidth.description: Bits per second the sheets take while playing.

mavio.library.v1.Trickplay.description:
Trickplay describes thumbnail sheets of one width: thumbnails taken
 every interval, row by row, tile_width across and tile_height down a
 sheet, thumbnail_count in all.

updateMask.title: update_mask
updateMask.description:
The ItemMetadata fields to change, by name; unset or empty changes
 none.

mavio.library.v1.ValueCount.title: ValueCount
mavio.library.v1.ValueCount.description:
ValueCount is a value with the number of items having it. Spellings
 that differ only in case, accents or punctuation are one value.

mavio.library.v1.ValueKind.title: ValueKind
mavio.library.v1.ValueKind.description: ValueKind names an item attribute listed by ListValues.

url.title: url
url.description: Relative to the server's base URL.

mavio.playback.v1.Attachment.title: Attachment
mavio.playback.v1.Attachment.description: Attachment is a file attached to a media source, such as a font.

maxStreamingBitrate.title: max_streaming_bitrate
maxStreamingBitrate.description: Bits per second; 0 means no cap.

maxStaticBitrate.title: max_static_bitrate
maxStaticBitrate.description: Caps downloads (CONTEXT_STATIC), in bits per second.

musicStreamingTranscodingBitrate.title: music_streaming_transcoding_bitrate
musicStreamingTranscodingBitrate.description: The bitrate audio is transcoded to for streaming.

maxStaticMusicBitrate.title: max_static_music_bitrate
maxStaticMusicBitrate.description: Caps audio downloads; 0 falls back to max_static_bitrate.

mavio.playback.v1.ClientCapabilities.title: ClientCapabilities
mavio.playback.v1.ClientCapabilities.description:
ClientCapabilities describes what a client can play: which containers and
 codecs it plays directly, which formats it can receive transcodes in, the
 limits of its decoders and how it shows subtitles.

 Lists of containers, codecs or languages are written as clients declare
 them: comma-separated and case-insensitive, e.g. "mp4,m4v". An empty list
 matches anything; a leading "-" means anything but the listed names.

mavio.playback.v1.CodecKind.title: CodecKind
mavio.playback.v1.CodecKind.description: CodecKind says which streams a codec profile applies to.

mavio.playback.v1.CodecProfile.title: CodecProfile
mavio.playback.v1.CodecProfile.description:
CodecProfile limits a codec: conditions must hold for direct play, and
 transcodes are made to satisfy them. The profile only applies to streams
 that satisfy apply_conditions.

optional.title: optional
optional.description:
Optional conditions hold when the property is unknown; required ones
 fail.

mavio.playback.v1.Condition.title: Condition
mavio.playback.v1.Condition.description: Condition is a requirement on a property of a stream or file.

mavio.playback.v1.ContainerProfile.title: ContainerProfile
mavio.playback.v1.ContainerProfile.description: ContainerProfile applies conditions to every file in a container.

mavio.playback.v1.Context.title: Context
mavio.playback.v1.Context.description: Context says whether media is streamed for playback or downloaded.

mavio.playback.v1.DirectPlayProfile.title: DirectPlayProfile
mavio.playback.v1.DirectPlayProfile.description:
DirectPlayProfile is a combination of container and codecs the client
 plays as is.

mavio.playback.v1.PlayMethod.title: PlayMethod
mavio.playback.v1.PlayMethod.description: PlayMethod is how a media source is played.

mavio.playback.v1.Property.title: Property
mavio.playback.v1.Property.description: Property is a stream or file property a condition tests.

mavio.playback.v1.Protocol.title: Protocol
mavio.playback.v1.Protocol.description: Protocol is how transcoded media is delivered.

mavio.playback.v1.SeekInfo.title: SeekInfo
mavio.playback.v1.SeekInfo.description: SeekInfo says how a client seeks within a transcode.

mediaSourceId.title: media_source_id
mediaSourceId.description: Plays this media source; empty picks the best one for the client.

audioStreamIndex.title: audio_stream_index
audioStreamIndex.description:
Stream indexes to play; unset plays the user's or the source's
 defaults. A subtitle index of -1 turns subtitles off. Selecting a stream
 requires media_source_id.

maxBitrate.title: max_bitrate
maxBitrate.description:
Caps the bitrate below the client's and the user's limits, in bits per
 second.

startPosition.title: start_position
startPosition.description:
Where playback begins, the resume position; transcodes start there at
 once. The response says where the client begins.
duration.gte = 0s

download.title: download
download.description:
Asks for a file to keep, which the user's policy must allow: the source
 as it is when the client plays it, else a progressive transcode to the
 client's container, never HLS. The URL serves it as an attachment.

playbackId.title: playback_id
playbackId.description: Identifies the playback in progress reports.

transcodeReasons.title: transcode_reasons
transcodeReasons.description: Why the source is not played directly.

url.title: url
url.description:
The media to play, relative to the server's base URL: the file for
 direct play, else an HLS master playlist or a progressive stream.

audioStreamIndex.title: audio_stream_index
audioStreamIndex.description: The selected streams; subtitle_stream_index is -1 without subtitles.

attachments.title: attachments
attachments.description: The fonts attached to the source, for rendering its ASS subtitles.

startPosition.title: start_position
startPosition.description:
Where the client begins: the requested start position, or the
 keyframe up to five seconds before it where playback begins without
 decoding frames only to drop them; the start of the HLS segment playing
 then, or for direct play the source's keyframe. Unset from the
 beginning.

position.title: position
position.description:
The last position; unset means the client played to the end.
duration.gte = 0s

mavio.playback.v1.SubtitleMethod.title: SubtitleMethod
mavio.playback.v1.SubtitleMethod.description: SubtitleMethod is how a subtitle stream reaches the client.

language.title: language
language.description: ISO 639-2/B codes; empty means any language.

mavio.playback.v1.SubtitleProfile.title: SubtitleProfile
mavio.playback.v1.SubtitleProfile.description: SubtitleProfile is a subtitle format the client shows and how it gets it.

streamIndex.title: stream_index
streamIndex.description: The stream's index in the media source.

url.title: url
url.description:
For SUBTITLE_METHOD_EXTERNAL, the subtitle file, relative to the
 server's base URL.

mavio.playback.v1.SubtitleTrack.title: SubtitleTrack
mavio.playback.v1.SubtitleTrack.description: SubtitleTrack is a subtitle stream offered with a playback.

mavio.playback.v1.TranscodeReason.title: TranscodeReason
mavio.playback.v1.TranscodeReason.description: TranscodeReason says why a media source is not played directly.

container.title: container
container.description: A single container, e.g. "mp4" for fMP4 HLS segments.

maxAudioChannels.title: max_audio_channels
maxAudioChannels.description: Caps the transcoded audio; 0 means no cap.

enableSubtitlesInManifest.title: enable_subtitles_in_manifest
enableSubtitlesInManifest.description: Adds subtitle renditions to HLS playlists.

segmentLengthSeconds.title: segment_length_seconds
segmentLengthSeconds.description: HLS segment length in seconds; 0 uses the server's.

conditions.title: conditions
conditions.description: Limit the transcoded video, e.g. its width.

mavio.playback.v1.TranscodingProfile.title: TranscodingProfile
mavio.playback.v1.TranscodingProfile.description: TranscodingProfile is a format the client accepts transcodes in.

key.title: key
key.description:
Key of the IDs in external_ids maps: lowercase letters, digits and
 underscores, starting with a letter, e.g. "trakt".

mediaKinds.title: media_kinds
mediaKinds.description: Kinds of media that carry the ID.

urlTemplate.title: url_template
urlTemplate.description:
Absolute http(s) URL of the page of an ID, with "{id}" standing for it,
 e.g. "https://trakt.tv/movies/{id}"; empty when there is no page.

mavio.plugin.v1.ExternalIdKind.title: ExternalIdKind
mavio.plugin.v1.ExternalIdKind.description:
ExternalIdKind is a kind of external ID, e.g. the ID of a movie on a
 metadata site.

configSchema.title: config_schema
configSchema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of the configuration object.

apiVersion.title: api_version
apiVersion.description: Version of this contract the plugin was built against, e.g. "1.0".

tasks.title: tasks
tasks.description: Tasks the plugin runs; requires CAPABILITY_TASK_RUNNER.

configPage.title: config_page
configPage.description:
Page among the plugin's HTTP routes that configures it, relative to
 /plugins/{id}/, e.g. "settings"; requires CAPABILITY_HTTP_HANDLER.

externalIdKinds.title: external_id_kinds
externalIdKinds.description:
Kinds of external IDs the plugin's providers give, beyond the built-in
 ones, so that clients can name them and link to their pages.

localMetadataFiles.title: local_metadata_files
localMetadataFiles.description:
Names of the files beside the media a local metadata reader reads, as
 patterns such as "*.yaml" or "movie.json" (path.Match syntax, without
 "/"); requires CAPABILITY_LOCAL_METADATA.

mavio.plugin.v1.Manifest.title: Manifest
mavio.plugin.v1.Manifest.description:
Manifest describes a plugin. It is shipped alongside the plugin
 (manifest.json) and returned by Describe.

mavio.plugin.v1.MediaKind.title: MediaKind
mavio.plugin.v1.MediaKind.description: MediaKind is the kind of item metadata is requested for.

httpHosts.title: http_hosts
httpHosts.description:
Host names the plugin may reach through the host's HTTP fetch, e.g.
 "api.themoviedb.org". A leading "*." matches subdomains.

readPaths.title: read_paths
readPaths.description:
Library-relative or absolute paths the plugin may read. WASM plugins get

Server services the plugin may call through the host API, as

actAsUsers.description:
Whether host API requests may act as a user named in the Mavio-User

events.description:
Event types the plugin consumes: a type such as "item.added", a
 category such as "item.*", or "*" for every event. Requires

mavio.plugin.v1.Permissions.title: Permissions
mavio.plugin.v1.Permissions.description:
Permissions are the host resources a plugin requests. An administrator
 approves them at install time; anything else is denied.

id.title: id

mavio.plugin.v1.Task.description: Task is a task a plugin declares.

fromSessionId.description: The session and user sending it.

tags.name: UserService
tags.description:
UserService manages accounts. All methods except GetCurrentUser and
 UpdatePreferences require an administrator.

tags.name: UserDataService
tags.description: UserDataService reads and updates the calling user's per-item state.

tags.name: AuthService
tags.description:
AuthService signs clients in and out. GetAuthInfo, CreateFirstUser and
 Login are public; the other methods act on the calling user.

tags.name: ItemService
tags.description: ItemService browses and searches library items.

tags.name: CollectionService
tags.description:
CollectionService lets administrators curate collections: named sets of
 items across libraries, such as a film series. Collections are items of
 the collections library; users with access to it list them with
 ItemService.ListItems and their members with its parent_id, seeing the
 members their policy allows.

tags.name: LibraryService
tags.description: LibraryService manages libraries and their scans.

tags.name: MetadataService
tags.description:
MetadataService corrects and completes the metadata of items:
 administrators edit and lock it, identify items again against the
 metadata providers, refresh them, choose their images and download
 subtitles. In libraries saving local metadata, changes are also written
 next to the media as NFO files and image files.

tags.name: PlaylistService
tags.description:
PlaylistService manages the caller's playlists: ordered lists of media
 items in which an item may appear several times, each entry with its own
 ID. Playlists are items of the playlists library that only their owner
 sees; ItemService.GetItem returns them and ListItems with their ID as
 parent_id lists their items once each.

tags.name: PlaybackService
tags.description:
PlaybackService decides how a client plays an item and tracks the
 playback. All methods act for the calling user.

tags.name: SyncPlayService
tags.description:
SyncPlayService lets online devices watch together: the members of a
 group play the same queue at the same position, as in Jellyfin's
 SyncPlay. Each change reaches the members as a SyncPlayUpdate event with
 the group and, when they have to act, a command timed in server time;
 clients keep their clocks in step with GetTime. A device is in at most
 one group and leaves it when it goes offline.

tags.name: SystemService
tags.description:
SystemService exposes server-level information and health, and the
 plugins the server runs.

tags.name: EventService
tags.description: EventService streams what changes to signed-in devices.

tags.name: SessionService
tags.description: SessionService lists the signed-in devices and controls them remotely.

tags.name: ActivityService
tags.description:
ActivityService lists the activity log: sign-ins, playbacks, changes to
 users, plugins and settings, and failures. Administrators only.

tags.name: BackupService
tags.description:
BackupService makes backups of the server: its database, the artwork
 chosen for items and its plugins. A backup is downloaded at
 /system/backups/{name} with an administrator's bearer token, and
 restored by starting a new server with -restore. Administrators only.

tags.name: LocalizationService
tags.description:
LocalizationService lists the countries, languages and content rating
 systems metadata and preferences refer to, with English names.

tags.name: TaskService
tags.description:
TaskService lists the server's recurring tasks and background jobs, and
 runs tasks now. Administrators only.

tags.name: DisplayPreferencesService
tags.description:
DisplayPreferencesService keeps the calling user's display preferences:
 for one client application and one view, such as the home screen or a
 library, settings whose names and values the client chooses, like a sort
 order or the sections to show. The server keeps them so they follow the
 user across devices.

get.description:
The file `StartPlayback` returned: the source file for direct play,
else the HLS master playlist `master.m3u8`, its media playlist
`main.m3u8` and their segments. Range requests are honored. The
playback ID is the credential.

206.description: The requested range of the file.

get.description: A subtitle stream delivered as a file, or the segments of an HLS subtitle rendition.
An attachment of the media source, such as a font that styled subtitles need.

An image, optionally rendered with the given size, quality and format.
Renderings without a format are WebP for clients that accept it, else
JPEG or PNG. The image ID is the credential.

get.summary: Collage of a library, collection or playlist

get.description: A JPEG sheet of thumbnails, such as `0.jpg`, of the item's trickplay at a width.
A backup's zip file, for administrators.
